notes.title: AZRAEL VERSION 2
notes.notes:
Arriving far before the deadline, but with everything promised and more, Azrael V2 is available for download. There is too much for me to spell out everything individually, but I'll try once more to give a recap.

-Fully implemented save system with New Game and Continue option
-Can now view acquired endings from title screen
-Main Area complete rework and expansion
-Updated VFX
-Several New Levels outside of the main maze
-Sticky collision on walls fixed
-Bug fixes
-Several important QOL additions
-Several file optimizations to further reduce game size
-2 New music tracks
-New SFX
-2 Secret endings
-More story points
-More collectables
-Several Dialogue reworks

and most importantly...

8 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS.
Thanks so much for playing my game, I hope V2 will satisfy your two dollars.
I tested V2 extensively myself, but it's entirely possible there may still be a bug or two. If you run into something, please email me at magicmischief101@gmail.com

Thanks again!

notes.title: Azrael Version 2
notes.notes:
Azrael has been out for a few days now, and Spafnar Studios has been working morning to morning to do a complete overhaul of the current version. Here's what the creator has to say:

"Azrael in it's current form is the way the game was meant to be played. Vague and empty with little to no quality of life elements. I've described it to a few people at this point as a "playable art exhibit."

Because of the reception being mostly "not bad" but just pretty confused, I'm in the process of reworking the game to add way more gameplay, an actual puzzle, more interactables, map optimization, more sounds and songs, and several story points to make the themes more comprehensive. 

It has a lot of things that require deep interpretation to understand, but I didn't want to just straight up confuse people and leave them with an unfulfilled experience. In essence; I'm quadrupling the game time, adding more depth, more explanation, more qol elements, and more achievements"

Azrael V2 is set to release sometime before the end of August.
